info.name: ACME Facility Incident Management API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the incident management API.

**Getting started**
1. Run `docker compose up -d` (or uvicorn locally).
2. Open **Auth / login** and send it. The token is captured automatically into the `token` collection variable, and every other request uses it.
3. To switch persona, change the email in the login body and send it again. Seed accounts all use the password `Passw0rd!`:
   - `admin@acme.inc` (admin)
   - `eng.hvac@acme.inc` (engineer)
   - `asha@acme.inc` (employee)

What each persona sees differs: the same `GET /api/incidents` returns every incident to an admin, only their own reports to an employee, and only their assignments to an engineer.

Path ids such as `incidentId` are collection variables, set once under the collection's Variables tab.
